site.metaDescription: Bɔ mpɔtam mmoafo a wotumi de wo ho to wɔn so nhyiam ma ahotew, nsiesie, ahoɔfɛ, turo ho hwɛ, nneɛma twe, afie mmoa ho hwɛ, mpanyimfoɔ ho hwɛ, nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nea ɛkeka ho.

site.hero.body: Bɔ ahotew, nsiesie, ahoɔfɛ, turo ho hwɛ, nneɛma twe mmoa, afie mmoa ho hwɛ ne nea ɛkeka ho firi mpɔtam gua baako mu.

site.hero.review: Mebɔɔ nsiesiefo bi a ɔte abɔntene yi so nhyiam wɔ simma 10 mu.
site.how.title: Mmoa wɔ nsa mia mmiɛnsa akyi
site.how.body: Firi "Mehia sɛ wɔyɛ eyi" kosi "wɔabɔ nhyiam no", a fon frɛ-nkyɛ-so, nsusuw, ne bo a ɛnna adi nni ho.
site.steps.0.1: Hwɛ mpɔtam mmoafo a wotumi de wo ho to wɔn so wɔ asase mfonini a ɛte aseɛ so, ntam ne nsoromma na ɛhyehyɛ.
site.steps.1.0: Fa adwumayɛ ne bo toto ho
site.steps.1.1: Hwɛhwɛ ho nsɛm, adwumayɛ, ne bo a ɛda adi ansa na woadi nhyehyɛe.
site.steps.2.0: Di nkɔmmɔ, nya bo a wɔabɔ na bɔ nhyiam
site.steps.2.1: Kyerɛw nkra, nya bo a wɔabɔ, na bɔ nhyiam wɔ app no mu. Adwuma no akatua nhyehyɛe yɛ tẽẽ wɔ wo ne boafo no ntam.
site.helpers.title: Fa wo nimdeɛ yɛ sika wɔ wo mpɔtam
site.helpers.body: Hyehyɛ prɛko na fi ase nya nhyiam firi mpɔtam nnipa a wohia nea woyɛ ara pɛ.
site.helpers.freeBody: Kora w'akatua nyinaa 100%. SwapSpot nnye komisin, ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu, anaa adetɔfo a wɔde ba ho ka biara.
site.perks.0.1: Kyerɛw wo nimdeɛ, mfonini ne baabi a woyɛ adwuma wɔ simma kakra mu.
site.perks.1.0: Hyɛ wo bo ne bere a wowɔ hɔ
site.perks.1.1: Wokura wo bo, ntam ne nhyehyɛe so.
site.perks.2.0: Nya nhyiam na soma bo a wɔabɔ
site.perks.2.1: Nya srɛ a ɛbɛn wo na fa bo a wɔabɔ bua.
site.perks.3.0: Nya adwene ne adetɔfo a wɔbɛsan aba
site.perks.3.1: Nya nsoromma a ɛdan adwuma a edi kan no adetɔfo a wɔbɛsan aba daa.
site.categories.title: Adwuma biara yɛ sɛn no, boafo wɔ hɔ
site.categories.body: Mpɔtam adwumayɛ nkyekyɛmu titiriw wɔ mfitiaseɛ, na yɛde bɛka ho bere a gua biara ayɛ kɛse.

site.trust.body: Adwene a ɛyɛ nokware, kokoam nkra, ne nhyehyɛe a ɛma mpɔtam nnipa di wɔn ankasa nsɛm so.
site.trustItems.0.1: Nsoromma ankasa firi mpɔtam nnipa ankasa nkyɛn bere biara a adwuma awie.
site.trustItems.1.1: Kora nkɔmmɔbɔ ne bo a wɔabɔ wɔ baabi baako.
site.trustItems.2.1: Bɔ ɔnipa biara ho amanneɛ anaa siw no kwan bere biara.
site.trustItems.3.1: Pepa wo akontaa ne wo nsɛm bere biara a wopɛ.
site.trustItems.4.1: Mmoafo na wɔkyerɛ sɛnea wɔkyerɛ wɔn baabi.

directory.indexMetaDescription: Hwɛhwɛ SwapSpot ɔmanfo adwumayɛ nkrataa denam nkyekyɛmu ne mpɔtam gua so. Hwehwɛ ahotew, nsiesie, nneɛma twe, nkyerɛkyerɛ, afie mmoa ho hwɛ, ahoɔfɛ, adwuma mu nimdefoɔ adwumayɛ ne nea ɛkeka ho.
directory.indexTitle: Mpɔtam boafo adwumayɛ denam nkyekyɛmu ne gua so
directory.indexIntro: Wɔyɛɛ nkrataa yi firi mmoafo adwumayɛ a wɔatintim wɔ SwapSpot. Ɛboa adetɔfo ma wohu adwumayɛ ankasa nhwɛso denam kuro, poso kɔd, mpɔtam, nkyekyɛmu, bo, kasa ne nsoromma so.
directory.statPages: nkyekyɛmu ne gua nkrataa a ɛredi dwuma
directory.byCountryBody: Nkitahodie biara a ɛwɔ ase ha bue ɔmanfo kratafa. Bere a boafo bi tintim adwumayɛ mpɔtam foforɔ no, ɛda adi ha bere a wɛbsaet no bɛsan ayɛ foforɔ.
directory.emptyBody: Wɔyɛ nkyerɛwee no firi mmoafo adwumayɛ a wɔatintim. Sɛ nkitahodie biara nni ha a, san ba nea ɛrenkyɛ anaa bue app no na hwɛ mmoafo a wɔbɛn wo.

directory.pairSummary: Fa {categoryLower} ɔmanfo adwumayɛ nhwɛso a efi mpɔtam mmoafo a wɔbɛn {market} hɔ toto ho. Fa app no di dwuma bere a woayɛ krado sɛ wobɛkyerɛw nkra, asrɛ bo a wɔabɔ, anaa wobɛbɔ nhyiam.
directory.popularBody: Adwumayɛ yi firi mmoafo ho nsɛm a wɔatintim mu, ɛnyɛ marketing nhyehyɛe a ɛgyina hɔ.
directory.areaBody: Ɔmanfo nkrataa kyerɛ mpɔtam, poso kɔd, nkuro ne adwumayɛ ntam na adetɔfo ahu mmoa a ɛbɛn a wɔnkyerɛ kokoam adrɛs.
directory.namesBody: Wɔhyehyɛ mmoafo adwumayɛ ma ɛyɛ nsɛmfua a wobetumi ahwehwɛ, mpɔtam nsɛmfua, ne nkyekyɛmu nkrataa na adetɔfo ahwehwɛ adwuma ankasa a wohia.
directory.inAppTitle: Nkɔmmɔ ne nhyiam gyina app no mu
directory.inAppBody: Wɛbsaet no boa nnipa ma wohu adwumayɛ. SwapSpot kora bo a wɔabɔ, nkra, nhyiam, adwene ne ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe wɔ mobaelo app no mu.
directory.faqTitle: Sɛnea ɔmanfo kratafa yi yɛ adwuma
directory.pairFaq1Q: Metumi abɔ {categoryLower} mmoafo nhyiam wɔ {market} wɔ kratafa yi so anaa?
directory.pairFaq1A: Wɛbsaet kratafa yi yɛ ɔmanfo nhwɛso ma nhwehwɛmu. Twe SwapSpot na kyerɛw mmoafo nkra, srɛ bo a wɔabɔ, kyɛ adrɛs pɔtee, na hwɛ nhyiam so.
directory.pairFaq2Q: Mmoafo adrɛs pɔtee yɛ ɔmanfo dea anaa?
directory.pairFaq2A: Daabi. SwapSpot kyerɛ adwumayɛ mpɔtam a ɛbɛyɛ te sɛ poso kɔd, mpɔtam, nkuro, anaa ntam. Adrɛs pɔtee yɛ kokoam na wobetumi akyɛ wɔ nkɔmmɔ mu bere a afã abien nyinaa ayɛ krado nko ara.
directory.pairFaq3A: Daabi. Mmoafo betumi ayɛ ho nsɛm na atintim adwumayɛ a SwapSpot nnye komisin anaa ɔha mu ka. Adetɔfo tua ka ma kwan bere a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔkyerɛw nkra, wosrɛ bo a wɔabɔ, anaa wɔbɔ nhyiam.

directory.cardsEmptyTitle: Hwɛhwɛ {categoryLower} mmoafo wɔ app no mu
directory.cardsEmptyBody: SwapSpot rebue mpɔtam mmoafo ho nsɛm denam gua so. Twe app no na hwɛ adwumayɛ a ɛbɛn, fa bo toto ho, na kyerɛw mmoafo nkra bere a woayɛ krado.
directory.cardsBody: Fa adwumayɛ, bo, mpɔtam, kasa, nsoromma ne mmoafo osuahu a ɛbɛn {market} toto ho. Adrɛs pɔtee ne nkitaho tẽẽ gyina SwapSpot mu.
directory.cardNoDescription: Hwɛ adwumayɛ nhwɛso yi wɔ SwapSpot, afei bue app no na kyerɛw nkra, srɛ bo a wɔabɔ, anaa bɔ nhyiam.

directory.noCommissionBody: Mmoafo kora adwuma akatua. SwapSpot nnye ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu anaa komisin firi mmoafo adwuma mu.
directory.servicesTitle: Nea {name} betumi aboa wo wɔ ho
directory.servicesBody: Eyinom yɛ adwumayɛ nhwɛso a wɔatintim firi SwapSpot. Bo bɛtumi ayɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, dɔnhwerɛ biara, efi ase, anaa wosrɛ a gyina adwuma no so.
directory.serviceFallback: Bue SwapSpot na hwɛ adwumayɛ yi, srɛ nsɛm, na si adwuma no kɛse so dua ansa na woabɔ nhyiam.
directory.areasBody: Ɔmanfo mmoafo nkrataa de nsɛm a ɛfata ma nhwehwɛ mfiri ne adetɔfo: adwumayɛ din, mpɔtam, nkuro, mpɔtam a ɛbɛyɛ ne kasa nsɛnkyerɛnne. Nkitaho pɔtee gyina SwapSpot mu.
